changelog: v0.31.13: C1 Phase 1 - add EmissionMap encryption. New TextureKind ColorEmission, OVERRIDE_EMISSION_1ST inline replacement preserves UV mode (4 variants), parallax, fluorescence, mainStrength, blink, blendMode. Limitations: BlendMask/GradTex/AudioLink fall back to default (no leak protection for those features). Tag toggle encryptEmissionMap default ON. Builds on the strip toggle (v0.31.12) so non-encrypted texture refs still nulled.
